description: Source code for the Installer class in the OpenCart marketplace controller, defining methods for listing, uploading, and managing extension installations within the admin panel.

classes.name: Installer
classes.description: Controller class managing marketplace installer operations such as listing, uploading, and installing extensions.

classes.name: Installer
classes.description: Controller class managing marketplace installer operations such as listing, uploading, installing extensions, XML processing, autoload generation, and vendor management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the installer interface, sets up view data and loads the template.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of installed extensions, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds and returns the HTML view for listing extensions with sorting and pagination controls.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles the upload of extension zip files, validating and extracting install information, and saving new extension records.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles the upload of extension zip files, validating, extracting install information, and saving new extension records.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installing an extension based on the provided extension install ID, including file existence check, extraction, unzip, and modification registration.

methods.name: xml
methods.description: Processes extension XML data for installing modifications and updates the database with modification info extracted from the XML files inside zip archives.

methods.name: vendor
methods.description: Generates a PHP autoload file based on composer.json files found in vendor directories, for managing vendor dependencies.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes an installed extension, deletes related files and directories, and updates the extension status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes an extension and all its associated files, directories, and modifications from the system.
